subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool activity become enabled by default for existing native macOS chat users?
rationale: The PR adds a persisted preference whose missing-key behavior changes an existing user's transcript presentation on upgrade; source correctness cannot determine whether that exposure and visual density are desired product policy.

options.title: Preserve the existing default
options.body: Default assistant traces off for missing preferences and let users explicitly enable them, preserving upgrade behavior while retaining the new capability.

options.title: Approve traces on by default
options.body: Keep the proposed default-on behavior with explicit maintainer approval and fresh-install plus upgrade proof documenting the intentional change.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing default
recommendation.body: Default assistant traces off for missing preferences and let users explicitly enable them, preserving upgrade behavior while retaining the new capability.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available product-direction owner for native Apple chat behavior and the persisted presentation default.
